messages:
Sam K: Heads up — Heliogen is asking about swapping from CompetitorX to Redwood. They want a short POC (2 weeks), answers to their security questionnaire, and a delta on pricing vs their current contract. Can we triage blockers?
Priya N: Thanks Sam. Key asks? SLA, model parity for their prompt sets, and data residency. Also will need a billing estimate for burst traffic.
Ethan M: Quick technical note — CompetitorX uses an API where the main field is `input` and supports `prompt_templates`. Redwood expects `prompt`/`messages` depending on route. We'll need a small translation layer for request/response mapping.
Sam K: They're particularly sensitive to response deltas — even small stylistic changes in outputs cause product regressions.
Lena V: Security questionnaire incoming. Primary enterprise blockers I saw historically: 1) KMS integration, 2) audit logs for per-tenant requests, 3) contractual SLAs around availability.
Priya N: Timeline: POC in staging for 2 weeks, can we offer a dedicated test pool for them? They want consistent latency under 200ms p95.
Ethan M: We can spin a Dedicated ephemeral pool but needs ops approval. For parity I recommend: a) translation layer to normalize request shape, b) deterministic sampling config (low temp, fixed seed where possible), c) response normalization to strip competitor-specific artifacts.
Ethan M: Example mapping (send this to eng-runbooks):
```
# CompetitorX -> Redwood mapping (pseudo)
POST /v1/generate  -> POST /v1/completions
body: { "input": "...", "templates": [...] } -> { "prompt": "...", "model": "redwood/gpt-similar" }
params: { "top_k": 50 } -> { "top_k": 50 }
stop_tokens -> stop
```
Ethan M: Also sample curl for their infra team to test: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/completions
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY"
 -H "Content-Type: application/json"
 -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-similar","prompt":"Summarize payroll changes","max_tokens":150}'
```
Priya N: Pricing question from buyer: they currently pay flat committed spend + overage discounts. Want to know estimated per-100k tokens cost and model substitution guidance for cost vs quality.
Sam K: Can sales draft a high-level delta: best-effort estimate + options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)? Keep it ballpark.
Lena V: On the security questionnaire, we can prefill KMS options + log retention. I'll attach a redacted sample of our enterprise packet. Need the customer's contact to match controls.
Priya N: @Ethan M — for the POC, can you scope the work for the translation shim? Estimate dev time and whether we can reuse our internal `protocol-adapter` repo.
Ethan M: Rough estimate: 3 dev days to wire up request/response mapping + 2 QA days for parity testing on the canonical prompt set (their 50 prompts). If we reuse `protocol-adapter` likely 1 day saved. Also need a small opplay for model fallback (in case of latency spikes).
QA Bot: @Ethan M please add an automated smoke test that compares CompetitorX response vs Redwood after normalization. Slack should show diffs and a regression metric (BLEU-like or edit-distance).
Ethan M: Agreed. I'll add a nightly job: run 50 prompts, compute token-level and semantic similarity, flag if >X divergence.
Priya N: For the POC, sales can offer 2 weeks of free test capacity up to 5M tokens. Legal ok?
Sam K: I can approve up to 3M free tokens; anything beyond needs legal pricing sign-off.
Lena V: Also needs NDA for audit logs. We'll attach the standard mutual NDA and the SOC2 snapshot.
Priya N: Action items:
- Sam: confirm token allowance and sign-off on NDA (today).
- Priya: send pricing delta email + get their current monthly tokens (today).
- Ethan: scope shim + CI smoke tests (EOD tomorrow).
- Lena: prefill security questionnaire and send enterprise packet (tomorrow).
- QA Bot: deploy nightly comparator and report template (in 48h).
Sam K: Thanks team. I'll call the Heliogen buyer at 1pm PT and share these items; will post contact details here after call. :phone: :eyes: 
Priya N: Thanks — ping me once contact is in, I'll start draft pricing.
Ethan M: Will put the initial PR in `protocol-adapter` and tag @Priya N for review.
Lena V: Adding note — if they require on-prem Private deployment, timeline expands (infra provisioning + compliance) — flag that in the sales pitch.
Sam K: Copy. Closing loop after the call.
